text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While tidying up after Tap Dance City's 
training session--

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
AHOY! Why don't you get out too? Any more 
than that would be overtraining.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Non-non! As long as my passion never runs 
dry, I will keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
For a brilliant future, for the world that 
awaits me, I will spare no effort—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm in! I've got a dream I wanna fulfill 
too! I won't spare any effort to make it 
happen!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm gonna stay behind and do some 
voluntary training before heading home. 
Cool with you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do everything in our power!
Yeah, let's do everything we possibly can!
Resting is the best option right now.
Resting is the best thing to do right now.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm gonna stay behind and do some 
voluntary training before heading home. 
Cool with you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do everything in our power!
Yeah, let's do everything we possibly can!
Resting is the best option right now.
Resting is the best thing to do right now.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good! Let's start running together! Aim 
for a glorious future!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even if the sun goes down, we're not gonna 
stop! Here we go!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City continued her self-training 
for as long as time allowed!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that while it wouldn't yield 
immediate results, the regimen was 
designed to benefit Tap Dance City in the 
long run, and asked her to trust me—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
OK, I'm in! If you're that confident, 
let's take a gamble on that plan.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, such deep trust. That is also a 
good choice!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Don't overdo it yourself either. —Come on, 
Trainer, let's head home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City took it easy and rested her 
body!
